Markets.title: Nifty eyes 26,200 as rally strengthens; 6 sectors signal outperformance
Markets.summary: Driven by strong foreign investments, the Nifty surged 2.61% last week to eye a resistance level of 26,200. While banking, IT, and financial sectors are leading this momentum, analysts advise caution against chasing extended market gains.

Markets.title: Stocks to buy: HSBC lists 19 Indian stocks that saw FY27 earnings upgrades, check target prices
Markets.summary: HSBC gave Buy ratings to 19 Indian stocks that received FY27 earnings upgrades following their second-quarter results. Ather Energy, GAIL, and IIFL Finance led these revisions amidst a broadening market recovery.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: These 13 stocks gained for 5 days in a row, all rose over 27%
Markets.summary: Over the five sessions ending November 20, the Sensex gained 1.08% while 99 BSE 200 stocks advanced consecutively. Thirteen of these stocks achieved cumulative gains ranging from 27.51% to 31.02%, led by Sera Investments & Finance India.

Markets.title: AI to lead investment strategy in 2027; Energy and borrowing costs shape macro outlook: Barclays
Markets.summary: Barclays Private Bank reports that artificial intelligence will lead investment strategy by 2027. However, rising debt costs and potential computing shortages could negatively impact these projects and hinder technology scalability.

Markets.title: Market winners: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers among 10 stocks that surged up to 14% in last week
Markets.summary: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers, and Blue Star led the Nifty 500 weekly gainers with surges of up to 14.14%. These ten outperforming stocks drove strong momentum across sectors while the broader index gained 1.5%.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields drop for day and week; AI trade concern spurs safe-haven bid
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields fell significantly for the day and the week as investor concerns about AI-related corporate debt and spending drove a shift toward safe-haven assets. Notably, the yield on the 10-year Treasury note dropped below 5% for the first time in several months.

Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
Geo-Political.summary: Finnish defense forces stated that Ukraine likely launched a drone attack on a Russia-bound ship in the Gulf of Finland. The vessel sustained damage during the incident.

Geo-Political.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
Geo-Political.summary: A tech stock sell-off led by sliding Anthropic shares dragged US markets downward. The S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average were both pushed into correction territory.

Geo-Political.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
Geo-Political.summary: Representatives from nearly 200 countries are deadlocked over fossil fuel policies during negotiations for a new global climate agreement at COP31. The disagreement has stalled progress as nations struggle to reach a consensus on addressing climate change.

Geo-Political.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
Geo-Political.summary: The FBI is reportedly investigating an apparent hack into its National Crime Information Center database. Law enforcement agencies at the federal and local levels use this system to share information.

Geo-Political.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
Geo-Political.summary: Mexican authorities arrested Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, a high-ranking drug lord on the FBI's 10 most wanted list, following a shootout. Meza Flores faces serious accusations of drug trafficking and torture.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool designed to help users reverse engineer applications and understand how they work without accessing the source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: Vedanta's Anil Agarwal pitches PSU privatisation, 3-fold employment growth and self-certification
Data & Insights.summary: Vedanta Chairman Anil Agarwal has advocated for the private management of government-owned companies. He also proposed achieving a threefold increase in employment and implementing self-certification.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi's ‘insatiable hunger for concessions’ remark rattles India Inc; companies prepare to defend jobs, salary growth
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi's criticism of India Inc.'s demand for tax concessions has raised corporate anxiety about future government support. In response, companies are preparing to defend existing jobs and salary growth.

Data & Insights.title: Budget expectations 2027: Gratuity hike, enhance social security, gig worker protection on list of trade union demands
Data & Insights.summary: Trade unions asked Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to raise gratuity limits, increase minimum wages, and expand social security during a pre-Budget meeting. They also urged the government to implement stronger protections for gig workers in the upcoming budget.

Data & Insights.title: Undisclosed foreign assets? Taxpayers can declare multiple holdings for  ₹1 lakh
Data & Insights.summary: Taxpayers with undisclosed foreign assets up to ₹5 crore can declare multiple holdings under the FAST-DS scheme. The Central Board of Direct Taxes clarified this option in newly released supplementary FAQs.

Data & Insights.title: RBI eases export paperwork for individuals, sets cap for service exporters
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has simplified export paperwork for individuals. It also established a specific cap to help banks process overseas payments for smaller service exporters more clearly.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Look into wage stagnation’: DEA Secy Anuradha Thakur calls on India Inc to improve employee pay – here’s what she said
Data & Insights.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur urged Indian businesses to address stagnant employee wages. She stated that better compensation would increase consumer spending and support economic growth.

India.title: UP Cops Mistake Asaduddin Owaisi For Supreme Court Judge, Give Him Guard Of Honour
India.summary: Uttar Pradesh police mistakenly gave a guard of honour to Asaduddin Owaisi after confusing him with an expected Supreme Court judge. The mix-up occurred at a circuit house when officers prepared for the judge's arrival but mistakenly saluted Owaisi instead.

India.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bridge Named After Nitish Kumar In Bihar's Vaishali
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a new bridge named after Nitish Kumar in the Vaishali district of Bihar. Following the ceremony, Modi and other political leaders took a brief walk on the bridge.

India.title: Analysis: BJP's Rural Reality Check - Congress Gains, RLP Expands In Rajasthan
India.summary: Recent rural local body election results in Rajasthan indicate strong anti-incumbency sentiment against sitting cabinet members. The outcome highlights political gains for the Congress party and expansion for the RLP.

India.title: Kerala-Linked Drug Racket Busted In Mumbai, Nigerian Man Among 2 Arrested
India.summary: Police in the Mumbai region arrested a Nigerian man and his Mumbai resident wife for their involvement in a drug racket linked to Kerala. The suspects have been identified as 40-year-old Ikechukwu Paul Ogbonna and his 42-year-old wife, Aarthi.

India.title: "No Takers For Railways In Meghalaya": Chief Minister Conrad Sangma
India.summary: Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad Sangma stated that the state has no takers for the proposed railway project in the Khasi-Jaintia Hills region. Consequently, the Centre is seeking the return of allocated funds, which could delay the stalled project by another one to two decades.

India.title: 4 Arrested, Stolen SUV Recovered Days After Gunpoint Robbery In Punjab's Pathankot
India.summary: Four people were arrested and a stolen SUV was recovered following a gunpoint robbery in Pathankot, Punjab. One of the suspects, Sheena, fled to Gujarat to evade capture before police tracked down the group.

General.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets Wes Streeting
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that recent strikes on the Crimean Bridge were a fair response to 109 Russian aerial attacks on Ukrainian bridges. He made these remarks during a meeting with British official Wes Streeting.

General.title: Catherine talks openly about how cancer changed her in documentary on BBC
General.summary: Catherine speaks openly in a BBC documentary about how her cancer diagnosis changed her. She explains that the experience shifted her perspective on a much deeper level.

General.title: 'We're not meant to carry life's challenges alone', Catherine says in first clip
General.summary: Catherine stated that "cancer does change you" and noted that people are "not meant to carry life's challenges alone." She made these remarks in a new documentary scheduled to air on BBC One on 29 November.

General.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
General.summary: Delegates from nearly 200 nations are deadlocked over a new global climate agreement at the COP31 talks. The stalemate is primarily driven by ongoing conflicts regarding the future use of fossil fuels.
